name: benchmark-MuliMedQA_tb-IFT
description: A multimodal medical question-answering benchmark that measures models' ability to answer clinical or medical questions using both text and visual inputs (e.g., images, charts). It focuses on accuracy and correctness of medical reasoning and image-grounded responses.
reputation: A specialized dataset for multimodal medical QA with limited but growing use in research on medical V&L models; not yet a broadly established community standard.
